Artifacts is the typed creation and publishing surface for durable Consuelo outputs. It replaces the older Office naming in the current OS tool manifest.

## What it covers

The current `artifacts.*` tools cover website and demo generation, digital guides, email and image briefs, motion frames, design-system lookup, validation, publishing, refresh, and related build/runtime operations.

A typical flow is:

```text
brief
  → choose the closest artifact workflow
  → create or edit source
  → render the output
  → validate the rendered result
  → publish when appropriate
  → verify the stable artifact route and version
```

## Skill and tools

Use the [Artifacts skill](/build/skills/bundled/artifacts/) for the orchestration rules. The skill coordinates the typed `artifacts.*` tools rather than introducing a second execution system.

## Boundary

Artifacts owns durable generated outputs and their versions. [Sites](/sites/) owns delivery infrastructure such as local/edge page materialization. Browser tools provide rendered runtime verification.
